p1 'POWER RATING P25 °C W' RS005 U = 5.0; p3 'Operating Temperature Range °C Characteristic U = -65 to +250'; p3 Derating figure CHAR. U: 100 % to 25 °C, 0 % at 250 °C (visually read). Method: Rth = (250 - 25) K / 5 W = 45 K/W. Linear derating means film/element temperature = T_amb + Rth*P reaches the endpoint on the derating line, so Rth_implied = (T_end - T_knee)/P_rated. This is the derating-implied thermal resistance on the manufacturer's (unstated) reference mounting, not a measured or board-specific value. Caveat: characteristic V (6.5 W, 0 at 350 °C) implies (350-25)/6.5 = 50 K/W for the same body, again showing the derating-implied figure is a rating construct.
